artworks.title: The Education of Achilles
artworks.description: Chiron teaching Achilles the lyre — the Pelion household Chariclo shares as the centaur's nymph wife and mother of Ocyrhoe. Not Chariclo mother of Tiresias.

artworks.title: Achilles and the Centaur Chiron
artworks.description: Batoni's Chiron and Achilles — the cave-school on Pelion where Chariclo stands in the Argonautica as Chiron's consort watching the heroes sail.

popCulture.title: Chiron
popCulture.description: Chariclo's husband — the wise centaur of Pelion; she is the nymph consort Apollonius places beside him, not Athena's Theban favorite.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius shows Chariclo with Chiron as the Argo passes Pelion — the centaur household waving the heroes off.

popCulture.title: Ocyrhoe
popCulture.description: Chariclo's daughter by Chiron — the prophetess turned into a mare for revealing too much (Ovid Met. 2).

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses (Ocyrhoe)
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Ovid's Chariclo watches her daughter Ocyrhoe become a horse — the Pelion wife's grief in the metamorphosis book.
